concepts.gloss_en: Rectification for the blemish of the covenant — the remedy (Elul kavanot) for damage done to the brit; construct head is 'rectification', with 'for the blemish of the covenant' modifying it

reason_for_human: Single occurrence; the phrase reads תִּקּוּן לִפְגַם הַבְּרִית ('a rectification for the blemish of the covenant'), where the construct head is the rectification/remedy, not the covenant itself. The gloss correctly captures this as the Elul-kavanot remedy for existing blemish. Nothing to split or merge.
